description: Task family: pinch, pinch_sinusoid, or downwards_rotate.
Experiment queue the run belongs to.
MuJoCo Playground environment.
Unique training run; join key to run_parameters_*.csv and the aggregate success dataset.
Observation/sensor bundle variant (compared policy axis).
Training seed of this run.

Evaluation rollout index (shared eval RNG stream, so a given index is the SAME initial condition across every policy and seed). Pinch tasks use fixed indices 0,1,2. Downwards uses the 3 most challenging rollouts (largest goal angle >= 90 deg).
Timestep within the rollout (0-based; 0..79 pinch, 0..119 downwards).
Simulated time = step * ctrl_dt (ctrl_dt = 0.05 s).
Total scaled per-step reward the env returned this step (sum of scale-weighted components + success bonus, times dt).
mujoco_playground commit used for evaluation (see success dataset dictionary; 0ac79f5 for the 6 pre-force-expansion force.magnitude runs, else HEAD 3682863).
Commanded grasp-force target this step (constant per episode for pinch; phase-randomized sinusoid for pinch_sinusoid).
Sum of the two fingertip contact forces (f_thumb + f_index).
Contact-gated total grip force actually scored against the target (force_error = effective_force - force_target). Equals finger_force_sum when both fingers are fully engaged.
Thumb fingertip contact force.
Index fingertip contact force.
1 if the success condition held this step (force within tolerance for the required hold time), else 0.
Target cube rotation magnitude for this rollout (constant per episode). All selected rollouts are >= 90 deg.
Cube orientation error to the goal this step.
Cube orientation error to the goal this step, in degrees (= ori_error_rad * 180/pi).
Raw action-rate reward component (pre scale weight).
Raw cube-on-floor penalty component (pre scale weight).
Raw cube-orientation reward component (pre scale weight).
Raw fingertip-position reward component (pre scale weight).
Raw joint-velocity penalty component (pre scale weight).
Raw wrist-velocity penalty component (pre scale weight).
Per-step success indicator used for the success bonus (1/0).
